reports.desc: Trying to say I was pre approved for a loan.
These people repeatedly keep calling, leaving messages regarding my past-due taxes. I don't have past-due taxes and haven't answered any of the calls.

They said I was approved for $5500.00 loan, but after filling in all the info they then said I was approved and all I had to do was make the first-time payment of 80.58 first loan payment,  didn't pay. But they have personal info. I'm elderly and needed ths for a deposit on a home.

I saw their ad on Facebook and thought the jacket was nice and I ordered it.  It came and doesn't fit and is of poor quality.  So I tried to send them an email (support@abrilene.com) about this and they won't respond back to me.  I want to return it but there was no contact information for them.  I had an address in Orlando, FL - 1234 Lakeview Ave., Suite 200, Orlando, FL 32801.  It was on their website and they won't respond to me.  My husband took the package to the post office and the address wasn't good.  I wanted to report this to warn others about them.

This business left a voicemail with an account number to call 877-870-8367.  I called them back and gave them my bank information.  My bank told me that this was a scam and they could not close my account.  I wanted to report this to the BBB to warn others.

Was told I was approved, transferred money in bank acct. proceeded to  tell me I needed to send a gift card on 2pccassions because of poor credit for insurance. They after gift cards they took the loan amt.of 2000. They even answered phone as Lightstream . Paperwork showed Uniersal and bank said payment came from Progressive

I received multiple text messages claiming I had won a prize from “MrBeast.” The scammer pretended to be MrBeast and said I needed to contact an “assistant” to claim the prize. The messages came from several different phone numbers, including (562) 384-0857, (248) 342-4286, (252) 499-5375, (510) 776-xxxx, and +1 (716) 936-0969.The scammer tried to convince me to respond and follow instructions to claim a prize, which is a common impersonation scam. They attempted to get money or personal information by pretending to be a well-known public figure. I did not lose any money and did not provide any personal information. I am reporting this to help prevent others from falling for the same impersonation scam.

Scammer reached out to me about a job I never applied to. They sent fake offer letters via email, reached out on Google Chat, and promised a remote position, 30 days of PTO, and reimbursement for work equipment.

Letter rec'd. in mail from Home Warranty Division from Golden Protection Group with my Lender Info:JP Morgan Chase Bank NA with my Full name, address, zipcode that my Home Warranty with Chase may be expiring or has alreaady expired. I thought it was from the warranty Dept. of Chase Bank of which i currently have a mortgage. It said to call immediately & "we reserve the right to revoke your eligability for service coverage with expiration date given. I called & deep man voice stated the same must pay $259 now to keep coverage. Reluctently was in a hurry gave credit card # stated i did NOT want it.  May cancel at any time. I immediately called my credit card, cancelled it & filed a fraud claim. I called my mortgage company after that  & mortgage supervisor stated " It's a SCAM"  Chase is doing a thorough investigation.
Paid for items never received. 3 months of emails and no refund or item.

I paid $100 deposit with balance of &50 for their assist in uploading my manuscript on KDP. I was not satisfied with the layout , they blamed it on Amazon, said if I don’t give them $50 they were going to steal my rights and publish my book
Under their own name and Jeff Luke said he didn’t need my permisdion to do it.

Athena AI was marketed on Facebook. Payment to join the system is $147. I paid. I was given access. The job is simple. Train AI to choose the most accurate answer from the most simple to the most challenging question, sometimes thru worded multiple questions or thru images. Ten task per day if you're on the 1st level but as you finish task diligently, your level goes up. The site is app.athenasystemai.us. Their minimum withdrawal is $700 and once I was to $2100 I tried to withdraw and could never get any assistance when the “system”’did not recognize my email.  As expected, no payment was ever made. Definite scam.
Dollars Lost: $147
Took my order and money, never sent the product. I attempted to contact customer service and never heard anything back.
